review: Reviewed selected existing runtime deltas, the new ManagedAiTextConsole module and suite, workspace stream discovery/grant/selection/publish/resume and native-cloud continuation paths, channel rendering and composer routing. Existing large-workspace coverage is not a claim of fresh qualification of every retained interaction.

Managed text has a distinct native funded route and session-only transcript; each explicit question is independent and bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Linked installation consent, reported minimum reservation and allowance gates precede submission. Unconfirmed outcomes block the same question without automatic retry; native/server funding and authorization remain authoritative.

Managed text hides the original visible composer while retaining its mounted room controller. Party Chat remains member text; the developer Room Agent shortcut posts a message for separate review rather than running work. Adapter activity remains read-only.

Personal Discord destinations are discovered from the native bridge independently of a Hosted Room. Hosted-owner destination takes precedence. Exact local read grants remain separate from finite source-set sharing approval. Current activity is baselined before selection; periodic heartbeat, revision and receipt checks constrain delivery. Closing the Float does not itself stop an approved background share.

Runtime fix 37 keys the workspace to the monotonic account revision and guards native/domain stream continuations before and after asynchronous calls. A delayed discovery cannot select a prior account destination, and a delayed local read-grant receipt cannot be forwarded under a successor account. Same-profile refresh retains drafts; an account round trip or unmount retires the old operation.

Two regressions failed before the fix. The resulting suite includes switch, round-trip and unmount cases; all native/provider endpoints are mocked. Account scope is a client attribution guard and does not add or renew any authorization.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal; runtime fix 37 and previous post-R380 fixes are not installed.
No real model request, key operation, account approval, stream send or game action occurred in these tests.

A request already accepted by native/server authority is not undone by client retirement. Cross-account cleanup must not be sent under the successor account; lease expiry and native account custody require installed verification.

Native funding validity, actual allowance expiry, live stream delivery/deduplication/revocation, protected resume, Windows Float custody and attended Minecraft/GPT Live handoff remain separate acceptance work.

Export tests load selected production modules with canonical unselected dependencies. Compilation externalizes npm and separately scoped dependencies; it is not full application typechecking or a rendered CSS check.
Five intentional support-contact matches elsewhere remain for exact public-candidate owner review.
